summary: Count local replication authority-guard summary calls without changing exports

replay.detail: No replay or projection behavior changes.

schema.detail: No stored state, table, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: Sealing, judging, authority digest and peer refusal decisions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive default-false local export request marker is omitted from ordinary requests and ignored by old daemons without deny_unknown_fields. Old clients get unchanged complete summaries from new daemons; signed peer exchanges never contain this marker. Two fixed count/wall labels are visible additions to the existing rolling performance report: replication/authority-guard and replication/summary, the latter counting every ordinary peer-summary export. They do not measure CPU.

downtime.detail: Normal rollout only; no profiler enablement or restart requirement for measurement.

manual.detail: No new endpoint or collector. Post-rollout guard share remains unmeasured until a bounded read from a reachable real node.

recovery.detail: Export failures still leave the guard requesting a push; no compact behavior or payload change.
